title: SysEvolve: An AI-native, safe, autonomous adversarial attack-defense co-evolutionary system
abstract: arXiv:2608.15012v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has created a growing asymmetry in cybersecurity, where attack accelerates toward autonomous execution while defense remains predominantly human-intensive. Despite substantial prior work across cyber ranges, AI-driven attack, and AI-driven defense, this asymmetry persists. We trace it to a deeper root cause, that evolution itself has stalled on both sides at three layers. To overcome this, we propose co-evolution as the integrating insight, where attack and defense AI agents autonomously and safely drive each other's evolution through adversarial confrontation. Based on this insight, we present \sysevolve, comprising three co-designed components, \sysfield, \sysspear, and \sysarmor. \sysfield constructs realistic multi-host ranges. \sysspear generates efficient, safe attack schemes. \sysarmor performs real-time, interpretable defense. translated_title: SysEvolve：一个AI原生的、安全的、自主对抗性攻防协同进化系统
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.15012v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展造成了网络安全领域日益增长的不对称性，其中攻击正加速走向自主执行，而防御仍主要依赖人工密集型工作。尽管在网络靶场、AI驱动的攻击和AI驱动的防御方面已有大量前期工作，但这种不对称性依然存在。我们将其追溯到更深层的根本原因，即进化本身在双方三个层面上都已停滞。为克服这一点，我们提出协同进化作为整合性见解，即攻击和防御AI代理通过对抗性交锋自主且安全地推动彼此的进化。基于此见解，我们提出了SysEvolve，它包含三个协同设计的组件：SysField、SysSpear和SysArmor。SysField构建逼真的多主机靶场。SysSpear生成高效、安全的攻击方案。SysArmor执行实时、可解释的防御。它们共同形成一个自驱动的对抗性循环。
tldr: 本文提出SysEvolve系统，通过攻击与防御AI代理的自主协同进化循环，解决网络安全中攻击加速与防御滞后之间的不对称性，实现安全、自驱动的对抗性攻防进化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SysEvolve, which addresses the asymmetry between accelerating attacks and lagging defenses in cybersecurity through an autonomous co-evolutionary loop of attack and defense AI agents, enabling safe, self-driven adversarial evolution.
